races.drawBiasExplanation: Longer distance reduces impact of draw position

verdict.comment: Sir Geoff Hurst, Cock And Bull and Maritime Lady are respected but EXPRESSIONLESS (nap) looks teed up for a big run.

comments.buxtedtoo: Last when 66-1 in a hot race 11 days ago but also has more to prove at this trip
comments.cockandbull: Two 1m6f wins at Sandown last summer, including on good to firm, and very consistent since
comments.contepartiro: Raced too freely at 1m6f penultimate start; last on turf debut (1m4f, good to firm) latest
comments.damascussteel: Has a more substantial record at 1m4f but best form last term makes him look competitive
comments.expressionless: Two 1m6f wins last year; promising reappearance over just 1m2f recently; big chance
comments.maritimelady: Won last two turf runs (1m4f/1m6f) last season, both in some style; up another 8lb
comments.saratogagold: Each-way case can certainly be made, even though his record at 1m4f is more persuasive
comments.sirgeoffhurst: Came home strongly for close fourth at Southwell (upped to 1m6f) in January last time
comments.tailorman: Won over 2m last August and September; others are more persuasive on his return

races.raceComment: expressionless is marginally preferred with a score of 56.0%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form over cockandbull. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include excellent form and optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Double Red finally delivered on his return but this is a longer trip and BEACH POINT looks a valid alternative.

comments.beachpoint: Had turf wins last May/July; 2nd on his latest three starts, close call on reappearance
comments.bobacious: Front-runner; two 1m2f wins last summer and back near his best when second 17 days ago
comments.bookoflife: 0-13 on turf and opposable judged on 2024 and 2025 turf results
comments.doublered: Back up 5lb since 1m win here latest, so he may have turned over something of a new leaf
comments.flatley: Sole turf win at Newbury (1m2f, good to firm) last July; 3lb lower now; AW win last month
comments.jewelmaker: 10yo who won last July/November; has a recent run under his belt and could be thereabouts
comments.timetellsall: 0-12 but placed in his last three outings, including twice over C&D; in the mix
comments.unplugged: Thrown in judged on turf placed form in three runs last summer but this is reappearance
comments.whatacracker: Not far away at Doncaster (1m2f) or Beverley (1m4f) on last two outings

races.raceComment: bobacious is marginally preferred with a score of 53.0%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form and more reliable profile over whatacracker. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 2 wins from 9 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include optimal distance and strong course form, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Inside to middle position preferred around right-handed bends

verdict.comment: There's little to choose between Comedian Leader and Havana Mojito on revised terms and the vote goes instead to EDVARD GRIEG.

comments.admiralfitz: Poor hurdler who's offered very little on the Flat, including on his handicap debut latest
comments.boleynforever: Massive prices for five runs last year (7f-2m); No News seems his yard's best chance
comments.cherryhill: Best efforts come at Kempton and last year's turf runs were poor; isn't obviously fancied
comments.comedianleader: Came right away with Havana Mojito over C&D latest and holds leading claims upped 3lb
comments.edvardgrieg: Another 2lb lower than when among the favourites at Nottingham last time; one to consider
comments.havanamojito: Solid C&D comeback; won second time out last season; fair chance history repeats itself
comments.heerssadie: Bit of promise in her C&D comeback behind two of these 17 days ago; case could be made
comments.hellavapace: Possible she needed her recent run and it wouldn't be a surprise to see her bounce back
comments.nonews: Has done most racing on the AW and regressed last year; record at beyond 7f patchy at best
comments.rohilla: The switch to turf and first-time headgear will need to make quite a difference
comments.shoplocal: Four poor efforts for Jack Channon; would want to see good support before considering her
comments.spiritlaadelita: Offered little hope for new connections back from a layoff on the AW 11 days ago
comments.voltaic: Visor returns after one run without it and he's capable if the return to turf gees him up
comments.werenotreallyhere: One of his better runs back on turf over C&D 17 days ago; never been close to consistent

races.raceComment: comedianleader is marginally preferred with a score of 54.8%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and superior course form over voltaic. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include excellent form and positive comments, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: The unexposed REBEL STAR is taken to follow up her recent breakthrough Yarmouth success.

comments.angleland: One win in her last 30 starts but has won over C&D and has dropped to a dangerous mark
comments.fouradaay: Second over 6f here eight days ago but needs a stiffer test than this; cheekpieces on
comments.gabriae: Progressive form a year ago; debut for a new trainer having had a wind op; watch market
comments.moeslegacy: C&D winner in November but then twice below form; may need this after 134 days off
comments.rebelstar: Off the mark at the eighth attempt at Yarmouth a week ago; no problem with the return here
comments.thecutest: Makes her stable/handicap debut after ten months off; not sure dropping to 5f is ideal
comments.wedgewood: Completed a hat-trick over C&D two years ago; could prove dangerous if allowed to dominate

races.raceComment: rebelstar is marginally preferred with a score of 55.0%, holding clear edges in more reliable profile over moeslegacy. Won 1 of last 5 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners, though step up in class and unfavorable draw need consideration.

verdict.comment: Pessoa is shortlisted but preference is for DRAFTED, whose two wins for Danny Brooke came over 7f on Tapeta in cheekpieces.

comments.alabamabelle: Showed more in a busy finish over 6f on handicap debut; has to settle better back at 7f
comments.barneysbay: Sharp regression last year having missed ten months; place likely the best he can hope for
comments.bunglebay: Little margin off this mark; didn't look to have any excuses behind Penny's Spirit latest
comments.diamondsinthesand: Hard to win with; nothing to suggest he's best caught fresh; Pessoa looks yard's best shot
comments.diddyman: Career-low mark; another furlong would have been optimal round here but he's considered
comments.drafted: Latest effort over 6f here is best ignored and he's one of the likelier winners
comments.dynamitekatie: Regressive mare; again goes without the usual hood; would be a surprise winner on return
comments.pennysspirit: Offered more on her C&D handicap debut three weeks ago; that gave something to build on
comments.pessoa: More consistent than most at this level and seems set to get involved once again
comments.toomuchtrevor: Regressive maiden for Alice Haynes; pulled hard when well beaten for his new yard latest

races.raceComment: diamondsinthesand is marginally preferred with a score of 52.1%, holding clear edges in more progressive over bunglebay. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include optimal distance, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
